body.message:
As per your request, please find below the 2-month rates for Elite Business Bay Residence – 1 Bedroom:

September: AED 7,000
October: AED 8,400
Total for 60 nights: AED 15,400

Please note that the above rate includes VAT, service charges, DTCM fees, and all utilities.

A AED 2,000 refundable security deposit is also required.

The booking will be processed on a monthly basis, with each month calculated as 30 nights.

To confirm and secure the booking, the first month’s rent, last month’s rent, and security deposit must be paid in advance. Once the payment is received, we will be able to reserve the unit and secure the agreed rates for the confirmed booking period.

Thank you.
